title: Palindromes in linear time
notes: Copy the word to tape 2, rewind tape 2, then read tape 1 backwards against tape 2 forwards. About 3n moves. The one-tape machine on the Turing machine page needs about n²/2.
ops: mark 0|1,_ -> copy -,$ S,R; mark _,_ -> accept S,S; copy 0,_ -> copy 0,0 R,R; copy 1,_ -> copy 1,1 R,R; copy _,_ -> back L,L; back 0|1,0|1 -> back S,L; back 0|1,$ -> check S,R; check 0,0 -> check L,R; check 1,1 -> check L,R; check 0|1,_ -> accept S,S
